reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a thermometer next to a plus sign, universally understood as increasing temperature, turning up the heat, logging a fever, or adding a temperature sensor. It fits many practical home, cooking, smart-home, and health tasks, though at tiny sizes the bulb and stem could briefly resemble a round padlock.
